# CNX Healthcare

> CNX Healthcare Pvt. Ltd. is a Mumbai-based pharmaceutical company founded in 2016 and headquartered at Shivaji Park, Dadar (W), Mumbai. It markets 400+ formulations through eight divisions — CNX, CNX Plus, CNX Prime, CNX Ortho, CNX Ortho 2, CNX Derma, CNX Gynec and CNX Cardio Diabetes — with a primary focus on CNS (psychiatry and neurology), and a presence in Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, Gujarat and Uttar Pradesh. All CNX products are manufactured by WHO-GMP certified partner companies.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2016, Mumbai, India
- Founder & CMD: Mr. Arun Shivram Bawkar
- Subsidiary: CNX Healthcare Plus Pvt. Ltd. (CNX Plus division)
- Primary domain: CNS — psychiatry and neurology
- Address: 3rd Floor, Laxmi Niwas, N. C. Kelkar Marg, Shivaji Park, Dadar (W), Mumbai 400028
- Phone: 022-25003690 · Email: cnxhealthcare@gmail.com
- Product information is intended for Registered Medical Practitioners only.

## Divisions
- [All divisions](https://www.cnxhealthcare.com/divisions/)
- [CNX](https://www.cnxhealthcare.com/divisions/cnx/): flagship CNS division
- [CNX Plus](https://www.cnxhealthcare.com/divisions/cnx-plus/): advanced psychiatric range (CNX Healthcare Plus Pvt. Ltd.)
- [CNX Prime](https://www.cnxhealthcare.com/divisions/cnx-prime/): CNS & pain care — antipsychotics, SSRIs, ADHD therapy
- [CNX Ortho](https://www.cnxhealthcare.com/divisions/cnx-ortho/): bone, joint and pain
- [CNX Ortho 2](https://www.cnxhealthcare.com/divisions/cnx-ortho-2/): extended orthopaedic reach
- [CNX Derma](https://www.cnxhealthcare.com/divisions/cnx-derma/): skin, hair and beauty
- [CNX Gynec](https://www.cnxhealthcare.com/divisions/cnx-gynec/): women's health
- [CNX Cardio Diabetes](https://www.cnxhealthcare.com/divisions/cnx-cardio-diabetes/): heart and metabolic health
